child.name: Keynesian macroeconomics / aggregate-demand management (demand-determined output with a state residual-demand-maker)
child.kernel: The redefinition of the economy as an aggregate SYSTEM whose total output and employment are DEMAND-determined and can stably settle BELOW full employment, so that government fiscal/monetary action is needed to close the gap. Net product: 'the economy is a single circular-flow object with an emergent equilibrium that can be STUCK at involuntary unemployment; the state is the residual demand-maker.' It welds (a) the classical/marginalist apparatus Keynes inherited from Marshall/Pigou with (b) the underconsumptionist insight that aggregate demand can be chronically deficient — fused via the proximate seam of the multiplier + liquidity-preference machinery. Born canonically with Keynes's 'General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money' (Feb 1936); but the TAUGHT object (the IS-LM / aggregate-demand model) was actually forged by the synthesizers (Hicks 1937, Hansen, Samuelson 1948/1955) — a re-weld + partial re-attribution.
child._frame_note: PRIMARY: knowledge (a theoretical/learned-competence render of the economy) + meaning (it reorganized what 'the economy', 'unemployment' and 'the state's role' SIGNIFY — it invented 'macroeconomics' as a level). time (a flow/circular-income dynamic; multiplier rounds over time). SECONDARY: space (national-economy bounded object; the closed-economy assumption, and the cross-country adoption pattern). A wide-frame child like the Modern Synthesis — and, like QG, it touches MEANING because in the absence of a single stable child, 'which Keynesianism is real / is one even needed' is an era-relative, observer-relative judgment.

utility._comment: Pav's three utility legs as prose + an enumerated affordance list.
utility.unifier: Welds the classical marginalist apparatus (Marshall/Pigou) to the heretical effective-demand tradition (Malthus/Hobson) AND, at a level up, unifies previously-separate price-theory pieces ('savings', 'investment', 'interest', 'money') into ONE aggregate income-determination system — inventing MACROECONOMICS as a level distinct from summed individual markets. Bridge degree high but CONTESTED: post-Keynesians say the synthesis 'unification' was a domestication that betrayed the original; new-classicals say the macro level is a category error (no real unification, just a mislabeling of aggregated micro). A disputed unifier.
utility.compressor: Collapses a mass of separate intuitions (gluts, hoarding, demand deficiency, unemployment, the trade cycle) into ONE short statement: output and employment are set by aggregate demand, which can settle below full employment because liquidity preference + the marginal efficiency of capital + the multiplier let saving and investment be equated by INCOME adjusting rather than the interest rate. Bits QUALITATIVE ONLY: the joint description (a demand-determined aggregate with an under-employment equilibrium) is plainly shorter than carrying classical full-employment equilibrium AND the under-consumptionists' mechanism-less demand-deficiency as two unreconciled accounts — order-of-magnitude only, no bit value computed (latent embeddings are a LATER step), and on a social/contested substrate at that.

parents.name: The classical / Marshallian-marginalist apparatus (Marshall's supply-demand + Pigou; Say's-law equilibrium economics)
parents.kernel: The inherited orthodox price-theory machinery: markets clear, supply creates its own demand (Say's law), the interest rate equilibrates saving and investment, and the economy self-corrects to full employment; involuntary unemployment is transient/frictional. Keynes was TRAINED in this (Marshall's pupil) and built W_C OUT OF its apparatus (he kept much of the marginalist calculus) while attacking its full-employment conclusion. CRITICAL TWIST: Keynes partly RECONSTRUCTED this parent as a single 'classical' bloc (lumping Ricardo, Mill, Marshall, Pigou) and attributed to it an 'always full employment' assumption that arguably no one quite held — a foil partly manufactured to be welded against (see discrepancy #1).

parents._parent_kind_note: Primarily CONTENT (the substantive equilibrium theory) but ALSO method: Keynes inherited the marginalist analytical apparatus (the calculus he reused) from this parent — a content/method straddle.

parents.name: The underconsumption / deficient-effective-demand tradition (Malthus's 'effective demand' vs Ricardo; Hobson; the Birmingham School/Attwood; Foster & Catchings)
parents.kernel: The heretical underground intuition — running from Malthus (who LOST the debate to Ricardo ~1820s) through J.A. Hobson to 1920s American underconsumptionists (Foster & Catchings) — that aggregate demand can be CHRONICALLY deficient: gluts and unemployment are possible because saving need not be automatically re-spent, so the economy can fail to absorb its own output. Had the INSIGHT but no rigorous mechanism; was scorned by classical orthodoxy for ~100 years. The 'content-parent' supplying the demand-deficiency idea Keynes made rigorous.
parents._frame_note: knowledge + meaning; a heterodox/heretical body of doctrine. Gains a time-frame only once embedded in the multiplier dynamics (the income-adjustment process).

The seam is NOT '1936 book meets classical textbook'; it is the move whereby Keynes accepted the classical identity I(r)=S(Y) but REINTERPRETED it so that INCOME (not just the interest rate) adjusts to equate saving and investment. That reinterpretation IS the seam — the layer where the two parents' vocabularies fuse into one calculable system. (The population-genetics analogue: as Hardy-Weinberg gene frequencies are the seam where Darwin's 'variation' and Mendel's 'factor' become one object, the income-determination system is the seam where classical equilibrium and demand-deficiency become one object.)

So the seam along which the parents were welded is itself disputed between the synthesis reading (IS-LM determinate equilibrium) and the post-Keynesian reading (uncertainty-driven, non-ergodic). The seam has a rift.

weld.surprise: A STABLE under-full-employment equilibrium that NEITHER parent predicts. Classical economics (W_A) says the economy self-corrects to full employment (Say's law); underconsumptionism (W_B) intuited demand could fall short but had no rigorous mechanism. Only the WELD — liquidity preference × marginal efficiency of capital × multiplier — shows the economy can SETTLE and STAY stuck at involuntary unemployment, with no automatic force returning it to full employment. Reachable only from BOTH parents jointly: the marginalist apparatus turned on the heretics' demand-deficiency intuition. SECOND-ORDER surprise: the weld INVENTS macroeconomics as a level distinct from summed individual markets — aggregate demand as a PRIMARY cause, and the PARADOX OF THRIFT (individually-rational saving can be collectively self-defeating, an emergent aggregate property absent in any single agent, exactly like a wrapper-level property not present in the parts). DEEPEST surprise: it makes the STATE the residual demand-maker, converting an economic theory into a permanent REORGANIZATION of the 20th-century state — a meaning-frame shift neither Darwin-of-economics nor the heretics articulated.

Without the multiplier (re-spending dynamics) and liquidity preference (freeing the interest rate from the saving=investment job), the two parents sit side-by-side and make nothing — exactly the 'two rocks in space = nothing; through time = strata' test, here 'classical apparatus + demand-deficiency intuition = nothing; through the multiplier = an under-employment equilibrium'.

dormancy_intervals._comment: (v1, R11) PRE-HISTORY DORMANCY of the W_B parent — the demand-deficiency idea was heretical for ~100 years before the Depression revived it. why_frame names the FRAME only; the external cause (the dominance of Ricardian/Say's-law orthodoxy) is intellectual, not a single exogenous event, so no forcing_events entry — this dormancy is knowledge-framed.
dormancy_intervals.why: The underconsumption/effective-demand idea (W_B) lost the debate to Ricardo; Say's law became canon; underconsumptionists were treated as cranks. A ~100-year heretical dormancy of the demand-deficiency parent, ended when the Great Depression created the demand for exactly such a theory.

dormancy_intervals._comment: (v1, R11) THE MAIN DORMANCY of the CHILD: ~1973-2008. CAUSE-FRAME SPLIT — partly knowledge-frame (stagflation falsified the naive Phillips curve), partly physical/political-frame (a FUNDED ideological movement displaced it from curricula and treasuries). A single 'why' cannot hold both (the Darwin+Mendel / QG cause-frame finding, here in economics). The EXTERNAL events (1970s stagflation; the neoliberal turn) are recorded ONCE in forcing_events[] — this why_frame names only the frames.
dormancy_intervals.why: Eclipsed by (a) the 1970s stagflation falsifying the naive Phillips-curve form Keynesianism had been reduced to (a refuting FACT), with the Lucas critique (1976) as the theoretical kill-shot; AND (b) the neoliberal/monetarist POLITICAL turn (Chicago funding + Thatcher 1979 / Reagan 1981) actively displacing it from policy and graduate curricula (a funded ideological movement). See forcing_events fe-stagflation and fe-neoliberal-turn.

revival._comment: (v1, R10) TWO revivals, BOTH reinterpreted (not same) — a STRONGER form than the binary 'same|reinterpreted' allows (see gaps). Each revival wakes a method-incompatible object under the inherited name. The fuller multi-cycle structure is in dormancy_revival (the rich prose field below) and indexed in lifecycle (D1); this object records the headline.
revival.by: (#1) Krugman/DeLong/Stiglitz + the academic New-Keynesian mainstream + G20/IMF; (#2) the COVID fiscal response + MMT advocates
revival.trigger: (#1) the 2008 Global Financial Crisis (conditions resembling the 1930s) -> near-instant G20 fiscal stimulus; (#2) the 2020 COVID-19 pandemic -> the largest peacetime fiscal expansion in history. Both are EXTERNAL crisis-pulls (forcing_events fe-gfc, fe-covid).
revival._kind_note: REINTERPRETED both times, and DIFFERENTLY each time. Revival #1 wakes a NEW-KEYNESIAN object: sticky-price microfoundations inside a neoclassical-equilibrium DSGE frame — closer in METHOD to Keynes's classical opponents than to Keynes. Revival #2 flirts with MMT, a different heterodox object again. 'same|reinterpreted' is too coarse: each resurrection wakes a structurally DIFFERENT, method-incompatible object wearing the same name (see gaps: needs a degree-of-reinterpretation / method-continuity axis).

reattribution._comment: (R10) the canonical NAME attaches partly to the WRONG node — the Maxwell-analogue. Direct sibling of the 'Maxwell's equations were the Maxwellians' finding.
reattribution.named_after: John Maynard Keynes ('Keynesian economics', 'the Keynesian Revolution')
reattribution.actually_produced_by: The durable TAUGHT object (IS-LM aggregate-demand model) was forged by Hicks (1937), Modigliani (1944) and Samuelson (1948/55) — the mediating welders. Keynes's own General Theory is verbal, ambiguous, and its IS-LM reduction was contested; Hicks himself later RENOUNCED IS-LM; post-Keynesians call the synthesis 'bastard Keynesianism'.
reattribution.why: The canonical name attaches to the originator of the RAW, contested form (Keynes 1936), not to the producers of the durable taught STRUCTURE (the synthesizers 1937-55). The weld CHAINS: birth-1 (Keynes) -> a second welding event (the synthesis) producing a structurally different, partly-DISOWNED object. Triple-attests the re-weld + mediating-welder variables and adds a 'disowned-mediator' wrinkle (Hicks repudiated his own weld).

weld_chain._comment: (R10) the weld CHAINS — birth-1's W_C becomes the input to birth-2.
weld_chain.birth_label: BIRTH-1: the General Theory (raw, verbal, contested)
BIRTH-2: the IS-LM / neoclassical-synthesis re-weld (the durable taught child; partly disowned)

weld._candidate_children_comment: (R6) EMPTY in the QG sense (no SIMULTANEOUS family of mutually-rejecting children at first zoom). The Keynesian child DID resolve (it was born and adopted). HOWEVER — and this is a finding — the schools (orthodox/IS-LM, post-Keynesian, New Keynesian, MMT-adjacent) are FOUR mutually-critical wrappers that disagree about what the child IS, but spread across TIME (successive revivals) rather than held simultaneously, AND they are descendants/reinterpretations rather than never-resolved rivals. They are therefore recorded as harvest.descendants + the feature_ledger + status_trajectory, NOT as candidate_children. A frontier note: 'candidate children spread across time vs held simultaneously' is a mode candidate_children[] does not cleanly capture (see gaps).
weld._weld_necessity_confidence_comment: (R8) 'is a third even NEEDED?' held at 0.78 (NOT empty/1.0). The weld is almost certainly REAL (the Depression and 2008 are hard to explain agent-by-agent; mass involuntary unemployment is a genuine aggregate fact). But its NECESSITY is genuinely DISPUTED by a serious new-classical / real-business-cycle / Austrian minority that holds macroeconomics is a CATEGORY ERROR — the aggregate is just summed optimizing agents (microfoundations primary; the Lucas-critique position) — a school that CAPTURED the discipline for a generation. So this is the falsifier-of-the-weld, LIVE, not 1.0. (Economics instance of QG's semiclassical-dissent slot, but stronger: the dissent here was the orthodoxy for ~25 years.)

lifecycle._comment: (D1) the weld's GRADED LIFE as a weighted INDEX over dormancy_intervals/revival/status/weld_chain above — does NOT restate their content. This is the RICHEST lifecycle in the batch (full multi-cycle trajectory). The whole trajectory is PACED BY EXTERNAL FORCES (forcing_events D4) — that pacing is the specimen's headline.

phase_trajectory._comment: (D1) GRADED trajectory, NOT an enum; the membership IS the soft value. Phases overlap. This trajectory is unusually LONG and multi-cycle (the defining feature). The 'when' marks the phase; the antagonism STRENGTH lives in pre_weld_relationship (not double-recorded here).
phase_trajectory.note: W_B (underconsumption) was a heretical underground tradition that classical orthodoxy (W_A) actively SCORNED for ~100 years (Malthus lost to Ricardo; Say's law was canon) — so the parents were antagonists-BY-STATUS before the weld, not symmetric complementary partners. A complementarity/antagonism straddle (see pre_weld_relationship).

Kahn's multiplier (1931); the Cambridge 'Circus'; Kalecki and the Stockholm School reaching it independently. The Depression (fe-depression) is the exogenous pull that creates the demand for the theory.
Keynes drafts and publishes the General Theory (Feb 1936) — BIRTH-1 of the raw object.

phase_trajectory.phase: consolidation/hardening (the 'Age of Keynes' / 'Golden Age of Capitalism')
phase_trajectory.note: BIRTH-2 (the IS-LM/neoclassical synthesis) + government institutionalization; pulled hard by WWII validation (fe-wwii) and the postwar settlement (fe-postwar). The taught child hardens.

Stagflation (fe-stagflation) falsifies the naive Phillips-curve form; the monetarist + new-classical counter-revolution; the neoliberal political turn (fe-neoliberal-turn). 'We are all monetarists now.' Not TOTAL dormancy (it survived inside the synthesis + New Keynesianism), hence membership 0.8 not 1.0.
The GFC (fe-gfc) crisis-pull -> instant G20 fiscal stimulus + New-Keynesian DSGE. Reinterpreted: microfounded, integrated with neoclassical equilibrium — method-incompatible with the original.
The COVID shock (fe-covid) -> largest peacetime fiscal expansion + MMT flirtation. A second, different reinterpretation.

phase_trajectory.phase: active-contested (never fully hardened nor fully stale; capacity-to-cycle demonstrated)
phase_trajectory.note: A live, repeatedly-buried-and-exhumed wrapper. Post-pandemic inflation re-opens the stagflation-era critique; rival schools coexist. The canonical economic instance of dormancy + squeeze/pull CYCLING.

pre_weld_relationship._comment: (R14) the SINGLE HOME for the antagonism strength. Distinctive here: a COMPLEMENTARITY-with-suppressed-antagonism — the parents were complementary in CONTENT (apparatus + insight) but antagonistic in STATUS (orthodoxy scorned the heresy for a century). Not a clean single kind.
pre_weld_relationship.note: PRIMARY complementarity (the marginalist apparatus and the demand-deficiency insight genuinely complete each other — the weld fuses them) but with a strong SUPPRESSED-ANTAGONISM component (~0.4): W_B was a heretical tradition that W_A's orthodoxy actively scorned for ~100 years (Malthus lost to Ricardo; underconsumptionists were 'cranks'). So unlike Darwin+Mendel's OVERT antagonism (Mendelism as an anti-Darwinian weapon), this is antagonism-by-STATUS/hierarchy, not open warfare — a complementarity/antagonism straddle. Graded: complementarity ~0.6, antagonism ~0.4.

weld_type._comment: (D1) WEIGHTED classification — a weld is SEVERAL types at once; the weight IS the soft value. PRIMARY tags.
weld_type.note: The Great Depression was the SQUEEZE on the old order that PULLED the new theory into existence and into government (fe-depression). The canonical instance of this type — the reason the specimen was chosen.

WWII deficits (fe-wwii) restored full employment exactly as predicted, VALIDATING the theory and mobilizing it into permanent government machinery (Employment Act, Bretton Woods). The war did for Keynesianism's CONSOLIDATION what the Depression did for its birth.
The durable taught 'Keynesianism' (IS-LM) was forged by Hicks/Samuelson, not written in Keynes's own contested text — a Maxwell-analogue mediator re-weld (see reattribution + weld_chain).

At the parent level: underconsumption heresy vs classical orthodoxy (status-antagonism for ~100 years) fused by the weld. Weaker/different from Darwin+Mendel's OVERT war — hence 0.45 — because the antagonism was hierarchical scorn, not open battle (see pre_weld_relationship).

It DID unify (price-theory pieces into one aggregate income system; invented macro). But CONTESTED: post-Keynesians call the synthesis-unification a domestication/betrayal, and new-classicals deny the macro level unifies anything real (it's mislabeled micro). A disputed unifier — hence 0.5, not 1.0.

PROPOSED in BATCH_FINDINGS terms but here promoted to a near-primary tag: the multi-cycle die-and-reincarnate pattern (birth -> hardening -> death -> two reinterpreted rebirths) is the specimen's DEFINING structural feature. (A candidate extension to the controlled vocabulary — flagged in discrepancy #8.)

NOVEL candidate type (flagged in discrepancy #1 BEFORE use, per §6 item 7): one parent (W_A 'classical economics') was substantially MANUFACTURED by the welder (Keynes) as a strawman/foil to be welded against, rather than found pre-existing. A weld against a partly-reconstructed parent. (A candidate extension to the controlled vocabulary.)

roots._comment: DOWN, in the PHYSICAL frame. Confidence FADES and depth RISES going deeper. The MEDIATING WRAPPER (the IS-LM/synthesis) is recorded in weld.mediating_wrapper, NOT duplicated here; the sub_wrappers below are the CONTENT/METHOD constituents the child is built from. The ground kernel '(0)' (people) lives in the top-level actors[] group as kind:individual — NOT here (v2 migration).

sub_wrappers._comment: The welding OPERATOR as a sub-wrapper (method root) — the real proximate machinery.
sub_wrappers.name: Kahn's 1931 multiplier (the welding operator)
sub_wrappers.kernel: The employment multiplier: an initial injection of spending generates rounds of re-spending (each recipient spends a fraction), summing to an amplified total change in income/employment. The device that made deficient demand and the gap CALCULABLE. (Pre-Kahn originators exist — see discrepancy #4.)
sub_wrappers.who_called_it: Richard Kahn (1931); Keynes (the 'investment multiplier', General Theory ch.10)

sub_wrappers.name: Liquidity preference (Keynes's theory of interest)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Money demand (transactions/precautionary/speculative motives) determines the interest rate, so the rate no longer has to equilibrate saving and investment — freeing INCOME to do that job. The device that lets the system settle below full employment.

sub_wrappers.name: The principle of effective demand
sub_wrappers.kernel: Aggregate output/employment are set by aggregate demand (the point where aggregate demand price meets aggregate supply price), which can settle below full employment. The conceptual CORE of W_C, rehabilitated from Malthus's 'effective demand'.

sub_wrappers.name: Marshallian marginalist apparatus (Marshall's 'Principles', 1890; Pigou)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Supply-demand price theory, marginal analysis, the partial-equilibrium method — the orthodox calculus Keynes was trained in (Marshall's pupil) and built W_C out of. A root of W_A.

sub_wrappers.name: Say's law / classical full-employment equilibrium
sub_wrappers.kernel: 'Supply creates its own demand' — the proposition that general gluts are impossible and the economy self-corrects to full employment. The classical CONCLUSION Keynes DROPPED; the thing the weld is built to overturn. A root of W_A (and Keynes's foil).
sub_wrappers.who_called_it: J.-B. Say; David Ricardo; (as a bloc) Keynes's 'classical economists'

sub_wrappers.name: Underconsumption / 'effective demand' heresy (Malthus; Hobson; Foster & Catchings)
sub_wrappers.kernel: The deficient-aggregate-demand intuition running Malthus -> Hobson -> 1920s underconsumptionists. A root of W_B; dormant ~100 years (the surprise_priority node).
sub_wrappers.who_called_it: Thomas Malthus / J.A. Hobson / Foster & Catchings

sub_wrappers.name: Wicksell's cumulative process (natural vs market rate)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Monetary-disequilibrium theory: a gap between the natural and market interest rates drives a cumulative movement of prices/output — a break from the quantity theory and a root of the Stockholm School's independent near-Keynesian content.

sub_wrappers.name: National-income accounting (the measurable aggregate)
sub_wrappers.kernel: GDP/GNP and the circular-flow accounts — the statistical apparatus that makes 'aggregate demand' a measurable object; developed alongside/after the theory (Kuznets; Stone; wartime planning) and required for demand-management to be operational.
sub_wrappers.who_called_it: Simon Kuznets / Richard Stone / wartime statistical offices
sub_wrappers._parent_kind_note: INSTRUMENT root — the measurement apparatus (the economics analogue of Fizeau's light-speed as Maxwell's calibration target): demand-management needs a measured aggregate to manage.

harvest._comment: UP, in the LATENT + CULTURAL frame. The tree grows to the present here. INCLUDES the rival/counter-children (monetarism, new-classical) that drove the dormancy AND the reinterpreted revivals (New Keynesian, MMT) — i.e. this specimen's 'candidate children spread across time' live HERE as descendants, not as simultaneous candidate_children. Also institutions-as-harvest (IMF/World Bank) per D2, and the austerity counter-movement as the dark cousin.

descendants.name: Neoclassical synthesis / IS-LM (Hicks 1937, Samuelson 1948/55)
descendants.what: The dominant taught descendant for ~30 years — the mediating-welder's product, also the durable taught child. A child of (Keynes x the classical apparatus, re-fused). Post-Keynesians call it 'bastard Keynesianism'.

descendants.name: Post-Keynesian economics (Robinson, Kaldor, the Kalecki lineage, Minsky's financial-instability hypothesis)
descendants.what: The heterodox 'true Keynesian' counter-child claiming the synthesis betrayed Keynes — keeps fundamental uncertainty + liquidity preference as the real seam; rejects the equilibrium frame. A child that disputes what the parent IS.

descendants.name: Monetarism (Friedman)
descendants.what: A RIVAL child born partly IN REACTION (the natural-rate hypothesis; money-supply rules over discretion) that DROVE the dormancy. An antagonist-descendant — generated by the weld it then suppressed.

descendants.name: New-classical / rational-expectations macro (Lucas, Sargent; Prescott RBC)
descendants.what: The antagonist-child: rational expectations + the Lucas critique (the theoretical kill-shot on naive Keynesian models) + real-business-cycle theory. Holds the macro level is a category error (microfoundations primary) — the school behind weld_necessity_confidence < 1.

descendants.name: New Keynesian economics (Mankiw, Romer, Stiglitz; menu costs, sticky prices, DSGE)
descendants.what: The 2008-era REVIVED synthesis-of-synthesis: Keynesian conclusions (demand matters; nominal rigidities) rebuilt ON new-classical microfoundations (rational expectations, DSGE) — closer in METHOD to Keynes's opponents. The object revival #1 actually woke.

descendants.name: Modern Monetary Theory (MMT)
descendants.what: The 2020-era heterodox revival flirtation: a monetary-sovereign government faces an inflation constraint, not a financing constraint. A different heterodox object again — the (partial) face of revival #2.

descendants.name: The Phillips curve (1958)
descendants.what: A descendant that became the FALSIFIED naive form blamed for the dormancy: an empirical inflation-unemployment trade-off, read as a policy menu, then broken by 1970s stagflation. The child's own most consequential vulnerability.

descendants.name: INSTITUTIONS as harvest: the IMF + World Bank (Bretton Woods 1944); national Councils of Economic Advisers; the central-bank/fiscal-coordination toolkit
descendants.what: The weld's most consequential PHYSICAL descendants — Keynes co-architected the postwar international monetary order (IMF/World Bank, 1944); the Employment Act 1946 created the US Council of Economic Advisers. A theory whose harvest includes standing GOVERNMENT MACHINERY (the D2/D3 bridge: a latent theory descending into physical institutions).

cultural_harvest.what: The entire MIXED-ECONOMY WELFARE-STATE SETTLEMENT — full-employment statutes, automatic stabilizers, the postwar social-democratic consensus; 'we are all Keynesians now' (widely attributed to Nixon, 1971, and earlier to Friedman in a qualified form). The weld's largest cultural/political spill: it reorganized what the 20th-c. state was FOR.

AUSTERITY politics as the recurring COUNTER-movement — the standing political antagonist that re-emerges each time the crisis-pull fades (1930s 'Treasury view', 1980s, post-2010 European austerity). The dark cousin of demand-management: the doctrine that the state should NOT be the residual demand-maker.

The post-2008 POPULAR REVIVAL of Keynes as a public figure — Robert Skidelsky's biography and 'Keynes: The Return of the Master' (2009); Keynes-vs-Hayek as a public-imagination framing of the macro debate; the meme/figure of 'Keynes' as shorthand for stimulus.

'Fear the Boom and Bust' — the 'Keynes vs Hayek' EconStories rap video (2010, Papola & Roberts), with a sequel (2011): the macro debate as viral edutainment. The clearest art/meme spill of the weld and its rivalry into popular culture.

National-income accounting + macroeconometric models (the Klein models; modern central-bank DSGE forecasting suites) — the computational/measurement apparatus the demand-determined view spawned, now standing infrastructure of every treasury and central bank.

relatives._comment: WIDE edges (SCHEMA_v2.md §2.5; still flagged for ratification). Cousins, influences, siblings, rivals spanning physical AND latent. The DEFEATED/RIVAL frameworks (monetarism, new-classical) are ALSO recorded as harvest.descendants (they are reaction-children); here they appear as RIVAL edges to capture the lateral-antagonism relation, mirroring QG's rival edges.

edges.name: Monetarism / the Chicago School (Friedman)
edges.note: The defeating rival that drove the 1970s-2000s dormancy ('we are all monetarists now'). Both a descendant (reaction-child) and a lateral rival — recorded in both roles, as QG's candidate-children behave like lateral rivals.

edges.name: Austrian school (Hayek; the Keynes-Hayek debate)
edges.note: The contemporaneous 1930s rival (Hayek's 'Prices and Production' vs Keynes's 'Treatise'/'General Theory') and the enduring free-market antagonist; part of the school that disputes the weld's NECESSITY. The 'Keynes vs Hayek' framing is the popular face of the whole rivalry.

edges.name: The Stockholm School (Lindahl, Myrdal, Ohlin; Wicksell lineage)
edges.note: A near-simultaneous INDEPENDENT sibling-weld reaching much of the same territory in the 1930s (and Sweden arguably adopted demand-management first) — the multiple-independent-discovery pattern (see discrepancy #3). A sibling, not a parent, because it developed in parallel rather than feeding in.

edges.name: Kaleckian / Marxian macro (Kalecki's independent effective-demand theory)
edges.note: Kalecki independently derived the essentials (1933-35) from a Marxian, class-conscious starting point BEFORE the General Theory; a sibling-origin and the root of the post-Keynesian counter-child. A reflexive curiosity: a sibling that arguably 'got there first' (Robinson's 'a neglected prophet').

edges.name: The marginalist revolution (Jevons/Menger/Walras, 1870s) -> general equilibrium
edges.note: The latent cousin that produced the W_A apparatus and, via Walras, the general-equilibrium frame the new-classicals later used to RE-ABSORB the macro child. The grandparent-apparatus that both built and (later) besieged the weld.

actors._comment: (D2) NEW first-class group. The SINGLE store for the ground kernel '(0)', generalized BEYOND people to institutions/governments. Actors are the BRIDGE between physical and latent: carrier_of pushes latent wrappers UP; inhabitant_of lives WITHIN other wrappers. This specimen is a HEAVY D2 case — governments and institutions are load-bearing (unlike Maxwell). Individuals first, then universities, then governments, then international institutions.

fuzzy_layer._comment: The LOD/confidence partition made explicit, as a DERIVED human digest of the per-node memberships (D5 — the memberships are ground truth; this two-bin split is a curated reading). certain_core = the trunk (high-confidence); frontier = speculative/conjectural + SCHEMA-STRESS notes. The DISTINCTIVE feature here: the fuzz is largely TEMPORAL — the child's IDENTITY is solid at any instant but drifts across decades, so the frontier includes 'which Keynesianism, when'.
certain_core: TRUNK (conf ~0.9): a weld happened — the General Theory (Feb 1936) fused a classical/marginalist apparatus to an effective-demand insight via the multiplier + liquidity-preference machinery, producing a demand-determined view of aggregate output/employment with a possible under-employment equilibrium.
The multiplier (Kahn 1931) and liquidity preference (Keynes 1936) are the welding operators; Keynes's multiplier is explicitly 'related to' Kahn's (General Theory ch.10) (conf ~0.9).
The weld INVENTED macroeconomics as a level (aggregate demand as a primary cause; the paradox of thrift) and made the state the residual demand-maker (conf ~0.88) — the surprise.
Government ADOPTION is real and consequential: WWII deficits validated it; the US Employment Act 1946 created the CEA; Keynes co-architected Bretton Woods (IMF/World Bank, 1944) (conf ~0.85).
The durable TAUGHT object was IS-LM, forged by Hicks (1937), Modigliani (1944), Samuelson (1948/55) — a mediating welder a layer up (conf ~0.85).
The 1970s stagflation falsified the naive Phillips-curve form and (with the Lucas critique + the neoliberal political turn) drove a ~1973-2008 dormancy (conf ~0.82).
The 2008 GFC and 2020 COVID triggered crisis-pull REVIVALS (ARRA $787bn; China ~$586bn; CARES $2.2tn) — well-attested external facts (conf ~0.85).

Surprise/synergy (a stable under-employment equilibrium; the paradox of thrift) is high-confidence even though the child is not (conf ~0.9) — the R9 decoupling, here from the 'born-then-reborn-different' direction.
frontier: FRONTIER — strawman-parent conjecture (conf ~0.6): that W_A ('classical economics') is a real pre-existing parent as Keynes characterized it. Multiple historians hold he caricatured/manufactured it as a foil (the 'always full employment' assumption no one quite held). The APPARATUS is real; the SHARP foil is part-constructed. = discrepancy #1 (highest-value; motivates a strawman/reconstructed-parent variable + the foil-constructed-weld type).

FRONTIER — the child as a single STABLE wrapper (conf ~0.55): 'Keynesianism' names at least FOUR mutually-critical wrappers (orthodox/IS-LM, post-Keynesian, New Keynesian, MMT-adjacent) spread across TIME; the revived-2008 object differs in method from the original-1936. The child is unstable-over-time. = discrepancies #2, #5, #7.

FRONTIER — the re-attribution (conf ~0.8 on the fact; the wrinkle is the frontier): the durable taught child was forged by the synthesizers, not Keynes; Hicks later DISOWNED IS-LM and post-Keynesians reject the synthesis ('bastard Keynesianism') — a disowned-mediator. = discrepancy #2.

FRONTIER — whether 1936 was a 'revolution' at all (conf ~0.65): contested from BOTH directions (Austrians/IEA: not a real break, the classics weren't wrong; post-Keynesians: a real break immediately betrayed by its popularizers). The child's very existence as a distinct wrapper is frame-dependent. = discrepancy #5.

FRONTIER — the dormancy's cause and extent (conf ~0.6): a CAUSE-FRAME split (stagflation falsification in {knowledge} vs a funded neoliberal political movement in {physical/political}); the '1970s death of Keynes' is partly an ideological narrative (it survived inside the synthesis throughout). = discrepancy #6.

FRONTIER — weld NECESSITY (conf ~0.78): a serious new-classical/RBC/Austrian minority holds macroeconomics is a category error (the aggregate is just summed agents; the Lucas critique). The falsifier-of-the-weld, live. = discrepancy #9.

FRONTIER — multiple-independent-origin / priority (conf ~0.7): Kalecki (1933-35) and the Stockholm School reached the essentials independently and contemporaneously; the multiplier has pre-Kahn originators. The surprise was 'in the air' once the Depression created the pull. = discrepancies #3, #4.

SCHEMA-STRESS (frontier of the MODEL, not the record): the strawman/reconstructed-parent (no slot), the diachronic candidate-children-spread-across-time (candidate_children[] assumes simultaneity), the revived-as-reinterpreted-DIFFERENTLY-each-time (the same|reinterpreted binary is too coarse), the disowned-mediator, and exogenous-forcing-as-the-primary-timeline all sit at the edge of what the v2 schema can hold — see gaps + discrepancies.
fuzzy_layer.core_boundary_locus: (R3-adjacent) UNUSUAL: the certain-core/frontier boundary does NOT sit cleanly at the trunk (Maxwell) nor sink below the child (QG) — it runs ALONG THE TIME AXIS. At any single instant the child is fairly solid (the 1948 synthesis, the 2009 New-Keynesian object, are each well-defined); but ACROSS instants the identity drifts (born -> hardened -> dead -> reborn-different x2). So the fuzz is DIACHRONIC: the core is 'the weld happened and reorganized the state'; the frontier is 'which child, when, and is it the same child'. A third locus-type beyond Maxwell's (fuzz-in-roots) and QG's (fuzz-in-canopy): fuzz-along-time. The vertical-position-of-the-boundary thermometer (BATCH_FINDINGS §D) gains a horizontal (temporal) reading here.

discrepancies._comment: THE highest-value discrepancy and NOVEL vs all prior specimens: a parent partly MANUFACTURED by the welder. Proposes a new variable AND a new weld-type (named here BEFORE use, per §6 item 7).
discrepancies.what: The second parent W_A ('classical economics') was substantially a STRAWMAN that Keynes constructed to be welded against. Multiple historians (IEA; Econlib; post-Keynesians) hold Keynes 'set up an utterly false caricature of classical theory' and falsely attributed an 'always full employment' assumption to it, lumping Marshall, Pigou, Ricardo and others into a single 'classical' bloc that no one quite held.
sources_in_conflict: IEA 'Keynes versus the classics — the true story' + Econlib 'Keynesian Economics' (the caricature/strawman case)
vs the General Theory's own framing (Keynes's 'classical economists') + the textbook Keynes-vs-classics narrative
discrepancies.why_interesting: The prize tension: in a normal weld BOTH parents pre-exist as real wrappers. Here one parent appears partly INVENTED by the welder in order to have something to fuse against — a weld against a reconstructed/fictionalized parent. The schema assumes parents are FOUND, not manufactured by W_C's author. Caps confidence on the clean two-parent rendering (~0.6). -> motivates a NEW variable 'strawman/parent_reconstructed_by_welder' AND a NEW weld-type 'foil-constructed-weld' (both flagged HERE before use, per §6 item 7; rendered at weld.lifecycle.weld_type with weight 0.55).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Lowers confidence in the clean two-parent rendering / in 'W_A as Keynes characterized it' to ~0.6; the APPARATUS-as-a-real-root stays high (~0.88). Does not touch surprise_confidence (the synergy is real regardless of how the foil was framed).

discrepancies.what: The DURABLE, taught 'Keynesianism' (the IS-LM aggregate-demand model) was NOT written by Keynes — it was forged by Hicks (1937), Modigliani (1944) and Samuelson (1948/55). Keynes's own General Theory is verbal, ambiguous, and its IS-LM reduction was contested; Hicks himself later RENOUNCED IS-LM; post-Keynesians call the synthesis 'bastard Keynesianism.'
sources_in_conflict: Wikipedia 'Neoclassical synthesis' (Hicks 1937 IS-LM; Modigliani 1944; Samuelson coined the term 1955; Hicks's later renunciation)
vs the canonical attribution of 'Keynesian economics' to Keynes
vs post-Keynesians (Robinson) calling the synthesis 'bastard Keynesianism'
discrepancies.why_interesting: Direct analogue of the Maxwell re-attribution finding (the Maxwellians forged the surviving 4-equation form). The canonical NAME ('Keynesian') attaches to the originator of the raw, contested form, not to the producers of the durable taught structure. The weld CHAINS: birth-1 (Keynes 1936) -> a second welding event (the synthesis 1937-55) producing a structurally different, partly-disowned object. -> triple-attests the re-weld + mediating-welder variables (R1, R10; rendered at weld.mediating_wrapper + weld.reattribution + weld.weld_chain) and adds a 'disowned-mediator' wrinkle (Hicks repudiated his own weld; see gaps).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: The re-attribution fact is high (~0.8); it lowers confidence that 'Keynesianism = what Keynes wrote' and supports the mediating-welder rendering. Adds the disowned-mediator wrinkle (not in R1/R10).

discrepancies.what: Michał Kalecki independently derived the essentials of the General Theory in Polish/French papers (1933, 1934, 1935) BEFORE Keynes, arguably in a more complete and class-conscious form; he declined to claim priority. The Stockholm School (Wicksell lineage; Lindahl, Myrdal, Ohlin) developed numerous Keynesian concepts independently and contemporaneously in the 1930s.
sources_in_conflict: Wikipedia 'Michał Kalecki' + HET profile + 'Did Kalecki Get There First?' + Robinson 'A Neglected Prophet' (NYRB 1976)
vs the standard Keynes-as-sole-originator narrative
discrepancies.why_interesting: The surprise (effective demand / deficient-demand equilibrium) was reachable from the parents by at least THREE independent welders nearly simultaneously (Keynes, Kalecki, the Stockholm School) — a multiple-independent-discovery pattern suggesting the weld was 'in the air' once the Depression created the pull. Bears on surprise_priority (R15) and confirms multi-origin is normal (cf. QG's multi-rooted origin). Kalecki-co-priority held ~0.7 (well attested but he never pressed it). Rendered at relatives rel-kaleckian + rel-stockholm and actor act-kalecki.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Does not lower the weld's confidence; multiplies the origin-roots and supports the crisis-pull reading (the Depression made the same weld appear in three places at once).

discrepancies.what: The 'multiplier' had numerous pre-Kahn originators: Dutch mercantilists, Julius Wulff (1896), Nicholas Johannsen (1890s), Alfred de Lissa and others — Kahn (1931) formalized rather than originated it. Keynes also distinguished his 'investment multiplier' from Kahn's 'employment multiplier' ('only a little different').
sources_in_conflict: Wikipedia 'Multiplier (economics)' / 'Keynesian economics' (pre-Kahn originators)
vs the standard 'Kahn 1931 invented the multiplier' attribution
discrepancies.why_interesting: The welding-OPERATOR (the multiplier) itself has a contested deep genealogy — a sub-weld priority dispute beneath the main weld. Mirrors Maxwell's surprise-priority (Faraday's 1846 light-guess) at the operator level. Low confidence-impact on the trunk; enriches the roots. Rendered at sub-welds sw-kahn-multiplier + sub_wrapper sub-multiplier.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Negligible on the trunk; slightly lowers 'Kahn ORIGINATED the multiplier' (formalized, not originated) while keeping 'Kahn made it the operative welding device' high (~0.88).

discrepancies.what: Whether the 1936 event was a genuine 'revolution' or an overstated rebranding is contested. Some Austrians/classicals (and the IEA) argue Keynes solved a problem the classics had not actually got wrong; the very term 'Keynesian Revolution' is whig historiography. Conversely post-Keynesians argue the revolution was real but immediately BETRAYED by its popularizers (Hicks, Samuelson).
sources_in_conflict: IEA / Austrian revisionism (no real break)
vs the standard 'Keynesian Revolution' framing
vs post-Keynesians (a real break, then domesticated)
discrepancies.why_interesting: Two-sided: the magnitude of the weld is disputed from BOTH directions (it wasn't a real break / it was a real break that got domesticated). The child is genuinely status-at-a-time and observer-relative — its very EXISTENCE as a distinct wrapper is frame-dependent (in {knowledge} it may be a relabeling; in {meaning}/{politics} it unmistakably reorganized the state). This is WHY frame_of_weld engages {meaning} (the QG-like reason). Rendered at child.status_trajectory + frame_of_weld {meaning}.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Lowers confidence that 1936 was a clean single 'revolution' to ~0.65; supports reading the child as observer-/frame-relative.

discrepancies.what: The dormancy is CONTESTED in extent and cause. The 1970s 'death of Keynes' is partly an ideological narrative; Keynesianism survived inside the neoclassical synthesis and New Keynesianism throughout, and the dormancy was driven as much by an exogenous neoliberal POLITICAL movement (Thatcher/Reagan/Chicago funding) as by the stagflation falsification.
sources_in_conflict: Wikipedia 'Stagflation' / 'Keynesian Revolution' (stagflation as the falsifier)
vs accounts foregrounding the neoliberal political turn (Thatcher/Reagan/Chicago) as the driver
vs the fact of survival-inside-the-synthesis throughout
discrepancies.why_interesting: Dormancy has a CAUSE-FRAME split (the Darwin+Mendel / QG finding): partly knowledge-frame (stagflation falsified the Phillips curve) and partly physical/political-frame (a funded ideological movement displaced it from curricula and treasuries). A single 'why' string cannot hold both. Confirms dormancy.why_frame (R11) with an economics instance: a theory can be SUPPRESSED by a political turn as well as by a refuting fact. Rendered at weld.dormancy_intervals[1].why_frame = 'knowledge, physical/political' + forcing_events fe-stagflation + fe-neoliberal-turn.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Lowers confidence in the clean 'stagflation killed Keynes' story to ~0.6; the FACT of the eclipse stays high (~0.82); confirms the why_frame split.

discrepancies.what: The child has NO single stable identity across its revivals: revived-2008 ≠ original-1936. The 2008 revival was New-Keynesian (sticky-price microfoundations inside a neoclassical-equilibrium DSGE frame) — closer in METHOD to Keynes's classical opponents than to Keynes; the 2020 revival flirted with MMT, a different heterodox object again.
sources_in_conflict: Wikipedia 'New Keynesian economics' (microfounded, DSGE, neoclassical assumptions)
vs 'Keynesian economics' as Keynes's own object
vs the MMT literature (2020) as a further different object
discrepancies.why_interesting: revived-as-REINTERPRETED, not revived-as-same (R10): each resurrection wakes a structurally different object wearing the same name. The seam S is non-unitary and itself contested (R12) — 'Keynesianism' names at least four mutually-critical wrappers (orthodox/IS-LM, post-Keynesian, New Keynesian, MMT-adjacent) that disagree about what the child IS, much like QG's candidate-children but spread across TIME rather than held simultaneously. Rendered at weld.revival.kind='reinterpreted' + weld.feature_ledger + harvest.descendants + S_structure.agreed=false. -> motivates a degree-of-reinterpretation / method-continuity axis (see gaps).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Lowers confidence in the child as a single stable wrapper to ~0.55; supports S_structure.agreed=false and the diachronic-candidate-children frontier note.

discrepancies._comment: The R9-confirming discrepancy, from a NEW direction vs QG.
discrepancies.what: surprise_confidence (~0.9) and child_confidence (~0.72) DIVERGE. The synergy (stable under-full-employment equilibrium; the invention of macroeconomics) is real and decisive; but the child as a STABLE, agreed wrapper is low-confidence because it has been pronounced dead and exhumed repeatedly and fractures into rival schools.
sources_in_conflict: the well-attested synergy (the under-employment equilibrium; the paradox of thrift) at ~0.9
vs the contested, unstable-over-time, school-fractured child at ~0.72
discrepancies.why_interesting: Confirms R9 (decouple surprise from child-confidence) from a NEW direction vs QG. In QG the child is UNBORN (high surprise, low child-confidence because nothing consolidated). Here the child was BORN, hardened, DIED, and was RE-BORN differently — high surprise, but lower child-confidence because the child is unstable-OVER-TIME, not unborn. A second, distinct MODE of the same orthogonality: synergy can be real while the child is perpetually-contested rather than merely-unborn. Rendered at weld.surprise_confidence (0.9) vs child.confidence (0.72).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Defines the gap between the two axes as the specimen's signature; neither axis moves the other.

discrepancies.what: Is a third wrapper (macroeconomics-as-a-distinct-object) even NEEDED? A serious minority (new-classical / real-business-cycle / Austrian) argues NO — the economy IS just the equilibrium of optimizing individuals (microfoundations primary; 'macroeconomics' a category error, the Lucas-critique position). The Keynesian mainstream and the bare fact of mass involuntary unemployment argue YES (the aggregate has emergent properties — paradox of thrift — absent in any agent).
sources_in_conflict: new-classical / RBC / Austrian (no child; the aggregate is summed agents; the Lucas critique)
vs the Keynesian mainstream + the fact of mass involuntary unemployment (the aggregate has emergent properties)
discrepancies.why_interesting: Confirms weld_necessity_confidence (R8) with an economics instance held at ~0.78: the weld is almost certainly real (the Depression and 2008 are hard to explain agent-by-agent), but its NECESSITY is genuinely disputed by a school that CAPTURED the discipline for a generation — the falsifier-of-the-weld, live, not 1.0. Stronger than QG's semiclassical-dissent slot because here the dissent WAS the orthodoxy for ~25 years. Rendered at weld.weld_necessity_confidence = 0.78 + harvest desc-newclassical + relatives rel-austrian.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Holds weld_necessity_confidence at 0.78 (not 1.0); the necessity is the disputed quantity, not the weld's reality.

forcing_events._comment: (D4) THE defining exogenous forcing of this specimen — the SQUEEZE that pulled the theory into existence and government. This specimen's whole lifecycle is paced by such events (see gaps: external_events may deserve to be the PRIMARY timeline axis for crisis-pulled wrappers).
forcing_events.name: The Great Depression (1929-33; ~30% GDP fall, ~25% US unemployment)
forcing_events._direction_note: BOTH: it SQUEEZED the old classical order (discrediting self-correction) AND PULLED the new theory into existence. Recorded as both because the pull on W_C and the squeeze on W_A are the same event's two faces.

acted_on._note: the squeeze on the classical full-employment orthodoxy

forcing_events.mechanism: The catastrophic failure of self-correction discredited classical orthodoxy (the SQUEEZE on W_A) and created the demand for a theory of mass involuntary unemployment, PULLING the General Theory into existence and creating an audience for it. The defining exogenous forcing of this specimen — and the reason three independent welders (Keynes, Kalecki, the Stockholm School) reached the same weld at once.

forcing_events.name: World War II (1939-45; US deficits up to ~$55bn in 1943)

acted_on._note: mobilized the theory into permanent government machinery

forcing_events.mechanism: Massive war deficits restored full employment exactly as Keynes predicted, providing a real-world VALIDATION the Depression-era arguments could not. Mobilized the theory into permanent government machinery (planning boards, the Employment Act, Bretton Woods). Keynes's 'How to Pay for the War' (1940) operationalized it (compulsory saving, deferred pay, anti-inflation). The war did for the CONSOLIDATION what the Depression did for the birth.

forcing_events.name: The postwar settlement (Bretton Woods 1944 + US Employment Act 1946 + UK 1944 White Paper)

acted_on._note: created the standing institutions (IMF/World Bank, CEA)

forcing_events.mechanism: Political consensus that mass unemployment was politically intolerable converted Keynesianism into the OFFICIAL doctrine of the mixed-economy state (Councils of Economic Advisers, full-employment statutes, the IMF/World Bank). The institutionalization that made the 'Age of Keynes'.

forcing_events.name: 1970s stagflation + 1973/1979 oil shocks

acted_on._note: opened the door for the monetarist counter-revolution

forcing_events.mechanism: Simultaneous high inflation AND high unemployment falsified the naive Phillips-curve trade-off that Keynesianism had been reduced to, destroying its policy credibility and OPENING the door for the monetarist/new-classical counter-revolution. The squeeze that caused the dormancy (the knowledge-frame half of the cause-frame split).

forcing_events.name: The neoliberal / monetarist political turn (Thatcher 1979, Reagan 1981; 'we are all monetarists now')
forcing_events._kind_note: kind: politics, with a strong FASHION component (the free-market intellectual fashion + a curricular/funding shift). Logged as politics primarily.

acted_on._note: displaced from policy AND graduate curricula for ~25 years

forcing_events.mechanism: A political-ideological movement (free-market fashion + a funding/curricular shift toward Chicago-style economics) actively displaced Keynesian demand-management from policy and graduate curricula for ~25 years — an exogenous fashion/politics squeeze LAYERED ON the intellectual (stagflation) one. The physical/political-frame half of the dormancy's cause-frame split: a theory suppressed by a funded movement, not only by a refuting fact.

forcing_events.name: The 2008 Global Financial Crisis

acted_on._note: the first revival; ended the ~35-year dormancy

forcing_events.mechanism: Conditions resembling the 1930s triggered a near-instant return to fiscal stimulus across G20 governments (ARRA $787bn; China ~$586bn; TARP $700bn) and a 'return of Keynes' — the crisis-pull that ended the ~35-year dormancy. Several prominent anti-Keynesians (Feldstein, Posner) publicly converted; ~300 economists (Barro, Prescott, V. Smith, Buchanan) signed against. Revived a REINTERPRETED (New-Keynesian, microfounded) object.

forcing_events.name: The 2020 COVID-19 pandemic
forcing_events._kind_note: An exogenous HEALTH shock acting as an economic-crisis forcing — arguably its own kind (a pandemic), logged as economic-crisis for its mechanism (a demand/output collapse pulling fiscal expansion).

acted_on._note: elevated the MMT variant into the policy conversation

forcing_events.mechanism: An exogenous health shock produced the largest peacetime fiscal expansion in history (CARES Act $2.2tn + four further bills), reviving demand-management AND elevating the heterodox MMT variant — a second crisis-pull, reinforcing the dormancy-revival-cycling pattern. A different reinterpretation again (MMT-adjacent), confirming revived-as-reinterpreted-DIFFERENTLY-each-time.

forcing_events.name: Cold War / McCarthyism (the Tarshis-textbook red-scare attacks)
forcing_events._direction_note: BOTH: it did not simply squeeze Keynesianism out — it RESHAPED which VERSION survived, pushing toward a domesticated form (a redirect), which is a squeeze on the radical content and a (perverse) pull on the safe synthesis form.

acted_on._note: pushed toward a politically-safe 'neoclassical synthesis' form

forcing_events.when: ~1947-1955 (the Tarshis textbook attacks 1947; the McCarthy climate early 1950s)
forcing_events.mechanism: Political pressure (the red-scare attacks on Lorie Tarshis's Keynesian textbook; the climate of McCarthyism) pushed Samuelson/Solow toward a DOMESTICATED 'neoclassical synthesis' that diluted Keynes's more radical claims to make them politically safe — an exogenous force reshaping which VERSION of the child survived (post-Keynesians call the result 'bastard Keynesianism'). A rare example of a forcing event acting on the FORM of a child, not just its rise/fall.
